artist.name: Kaamin
artist.bio: Kaamin is an Indian DJ and producer of melodic techno and breaks who recorded the first Hideout live set at Stakna Monastery in Ladakh in 2022. His track 'Vigil' with Sid Praja appears on Padmini Records' compilation Yaar-Dost Vol. 2 (2026).

rels.title: Vigil (with Sid Praja, on Yaar-Dost Vol. 2)
rels.label: Padmini Records
